text:
emily: Quick offsite logistics q: hotel is assigning double rooms. Do people want roommate prefs? (early riser/night owl, snorer, AC temp, allergies) Trying to avoid 3am thermostat wars. 
rafael: YES please. I'm an early riser, light sleeper, non-snorer, allergic to cats. Prefer cooler temp.
zoe: Night owl, occasional snorer (sorry in advance), sleeps with white noise. No allergies. Happy to room with early riser if there's earplugs.
tara: I'm a very light sleeper too, non-smoker, prefers warmer room. Also prefers top bunk... jk. :laughing:
travel-planning: Thanks! We'll collect these and do a quick matching. Please DM me any non-revealed medical needs. We'll try to honor AC prefs but can't guarantee.
emily: Poll: should we let people pick "quiet room" vs "social room"? Quiet room = no guests, lights-out by 11pm. Social = ok for small group hangouts in room. Reply with :quiet: or :tada:
rafael: :quiet: -- I work early mornings.
zoe: :tada: -- love late-night board games.
tara: :quiet: if possible. Also, can we add a shared list of things the team can borrow? e.g., surge strip, phone charging dock, travel adapter?
hotel-bot: Note: property offers loaner adapters and irons at front desk. See policy: https://hotel.example/loaners.
travel-planning: Good call. Adding "surge strip + adapters + spare toiletries" to the shared travel kit. We'll also try to avoid pairing heavy snorers with light sleepers.
emily: Thanks folks. If you're flexible on roommate, please add "flex" after your name so we can optimize pairings.
zoe: Flex (can take early/late). Also bringing my white-noise app and spare earplugs for teammates.
rafael: Flex but prefer quiet.
tara: Not-flex, pls. Need my 9hrs.
emily: Perfect. Will circulate final roommate list and room expectations doc 72h before travel. Also shoutout to whoever invented white-noise playlists 64f5 :heart:
